subject: checkpoint to manage stable and dev bioconductor release?

messages.author: a68df3015a3e3c69
messages.subject: checkpoint to manage stable and dev bioconductor release?
parts:
Hi,
I want to test some of my scripts with new features in packages in the development version of bioconductor. However, I don't want to install the development version of bioconductor system wide and want to default to using the stable version of bioconductor for all my scripts. Can I use the checkpoint package to use the bioconductor development version just for a few test scripts?

messages.author: 149440eddb848db9
messages.subject: Re: checkpoint to manage stable and dev bioconductor release?
parts:
Hi, Jake

This is an interesting question, thank you.  Right now, checkpoint doesn't offer any support for BioConductor, so it's not going to be of any help.

However, you can achieve your goal really easily if you use Hadley's devtools package.

Use:

library(devtools)
dev_mode(TRUE)
install.packages(...)

This will install your packages in a temporary development environment.  You have fine grained control - you can specify a path as an argument to dev_mode()

Good luck with your project.

Andrie
